description: Fetch details of a single Twitch clip by URL or bare slug via Twitch's internal GraphQL (no login, no browser). Clips are short viewer-created highlights; returns title, owning channel, game/category, view count, clipper name, duration, creation date, thumbnail, and the source VOD reference when available (sourceVideoUrl is null when the clip has no accessible source broadcast). The clip's chat is a real-time message stream and is intentionally not included. Input URLs come from twitch/get-channel-clips results. Returns NOT_FOUND for nonexistent slugs.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Full clip URL (https://www.twitch.tv/{channel}/clip/{slug}) or a bare clip slug ({slug}). The slug is the true identifier, so the channel segment is ignored; a trailing ?range= query string (e.g. ?range=7d) is stripped automatically. Examples: "https://www.twitch.tv/lck/clip/ObeseDarkLapwingPartyTime-sYFEmpufSo89ELev" or "ObeseDarkLapwingPartyTime-sYFEmpufSo89ELev". URLs come from twitch/get-channel-clips results.
